content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Vacancy Details 2027
content_sections.text: BHEL has announced 660 Artisan Grade-IV vacancies across seven trades.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Unit-Wise Vacancy Details 2027
content_sections.text: The vacancies are distributed among nine BHEL manufacturing units in Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Uttarakhand, Telangana, Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh. Candidates must select their manufacturing unit and trade carefully because the Computer Based Examination is scheduled on the same day for all notified vacancies.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Category-Wise Vacancy Details 2027
content_sections.text: The notification also identifies horizontal reservation for eligible Persons with Disabilities and Ex-servicemen. These vacancies are included within the advertised total and should not be added again.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Eligibility Criteria 2027
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess all three of the following qualifications in the relevant trade: Class 10 or Matriculation. National Trade Certificate (NTC/ITI). National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC). The qualification cut-off date is 1 October 2026 . Candidates must have obtained the required ITI/NTC and NAC certificates or marksheets by this date. Only full-time regular courses will be considered. The National Apprenticeship Certificate must be issued by the competent authority. Special Condition: SC/ST/PwBD candidates applying against vacancies not reserved for their respective categories will be considered under general merit standards, without relaxation in the minimum educational percentage. Eligible Ex-servicemen claiming prescribed trade equivalency may receive the notified exemption from minimum marks requirements. Knowledge of the regional language is desirable for manufacturing units in Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka. Hindi knowledge is desirable for the other manufacturing units.

rows.minimum_marks: 55% in both NTC/ITI and NAC, subject to the applicable reservation conditions

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Age Limit 2027
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for General and EWS candidates is 27 years as of 1 October 2026 . Maximum Age Ceiling: The age of a candidate, including all permissible relaxations, must not exceed 56 years as of 1 October 2026. Applicants claiming work-experience-based relaxation must submit the relevant experience certificate in the format prescribed by BHEL.

rows.age_relaxation: Up to 7 Years, subject to at least 6 months of eligible experience and prescribed proof

rows.category: Eligible Jammu and Kashmir Domiciled Candidates (1980–1989)

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Salary 2027
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will initially work as Temporary Artisans for one year with consolidated monthly wages of Rs. 24,000. Upon successful completion of the temporary period, candidates will be regularized in the Artisan Grade-IV establishment according to the prevailing company rules. Applicable allowances will be provided as per the rules in force at regularization.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Selection Process 2027
content_sections.text: Selection is conducted through a two-stage process consisting of a Computer Based Examination followed by Document Verification and a qualifying Skill Test. Stage I: Computer Based Examination (CBE). Stage II: Document Verification and Skill Test. Final Merit: Based on CBE marks among candidates found eligible in document verification and qualified in the Skill Test. Candidates are generally shortlisted for the Skill Test in the ratio of 1:3 against the available category-wise vacancies for the relevant unit and trade. For a single vacancy in a trade/category, up to five candidates may be shortlisted. For eligible PwBD and Ex-servicemen candidates, the notification permits further qualifying-mark relaxation under specified conditions, subject to minimum standards of 30% for UR/EWS and 22.5% for OBC/SC/ST. The Skill Test is qualifying in nature. Final merit is determined by CBE marks after successful completion of document verification and the Skill Test.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Exam Pattern 2027
content_sections.text: The BHEL Artisan Computer Based Examination will contain 120 multiple-choice questions carrying 120 marks, with a duration of 90 minutes . Examination Mode: Computer Based Examination Question Type: Objective Multiple Choice Total Questions: 120 Total Marks: 120 Examination Duration: 90 Minutes Correct Answer: 1 Mark Incorrect Answer: Deduction of 0.25 Mark Languages: Hindi, English and one selected regional language option The examination will be trilingual. Candidates may choose Hindi, English or a notified regional language such as Kannada, Telugu or Tamil. Where the English and Hindi versions differ, the English version will be treated as authentic.

content_sections.text: According to the official examination pattern, candidates will be tested in three areas: The supplied examination pattern document specifies the number of questions for each section but does not provide a detailed chapter-wise syllabus. Candidates should follow any subsequent trade-specific syllabus or examination instructions published by BHEL.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Application Fee 2027
content_sections.text: The prescribed application and processing fees are non-refundable . Additional banking or payment transaction charges may apply depending on the payment method.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Posting and Transfer Conditions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must serve at their allocated manufacturing unit for at least 20 years from the date of joining . Requests for transfer or change in place of posting will not be entertained during the first 20 years. The notification also specifies that any transfer considered in exceptional personal circumstances would be subject to availability of a suitable position and other company conditions. Applicants should therefore choose the manufacturing unit carefully, considering long-term employment and location preferences.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2027
content_sections.text: Important: If multiple online applications are submitted by the same candidate, only the last submitted application will be considered final. Applicants should ensure that the selected trade, manufacturing unit and category are correct before final submission.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: BHEL has announced 660 Artisan Grade-IV vacancies across seven trades and nine manufacturing units.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: The closing date for online applications is 18 November 2026 at 11:45 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for BHEL Artisan Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess Class 10, an NTC/ITI certificate and a National Apprenticeship Certificate in the relevant trade, meeting the prescribed marks requirements.

faq.question: Q4. Is an ITI certificate alone sufficient?
faq.answer: No. The notification requires both NTC/ITI and NAC qualifications in addition to Class 10, subject to the prescribed conditions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BHEL Artisan Recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for General/EWS candidates is 27 years as of 1 October 2026. Eligible category and experience-based relaxations are applicable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for BHEL Artisan Grade-IV?
faq.answer: Selected candidates initially receive Rs. 24,000 per month during the one-year temporary Artisan period. After successful regularization, the applicable pay scale is Rs. 29,500 - 65,000.

faq.question: Q7. What is the BHEL Artisan Recruitment selection process?
faq.answer: Selection involves a Computer Based Examination followed by Document Verification and a qualifying Skill Test. Final merit is prepared using CBE marks among candidates who qualify in the subsequent stages.

faq.question: Q8. How many questions are in the BHEL Artisan examination?
faq.answer: The examination contains 120 objective questions carrying 120 marks, with a duration of 90 minutes and one-fourth negative marking.
